title: Cutinapp — corrigir pesquisa global indisponível
scope: Restaurar a pesquisa global da Cutinapp que falha no navegador ao chamar /global-search, mantendo a sessão analítica da busca e sem degradar os demais endpoints.
acceptance: Busca global deixa de ser bloqueada pelo navegador
X-Search-Session é aceito pelo CORS da API
Endpoints /global-search, /global-search/suggestions e /global-search/discover continuam usando o cabeçalho de sessão
Alteração é mínima e não amplia origens ou métodos CORS
evidence: API main commit 81c228762c9d5f3288b1f285e2bb622acab51304 adds X-Search-Session to config/cors.php
Production hotfix applied to /var/www/api.petertecnet.com.br/config/cors.php and Laravel config cache rebuilt successfully
Production CORS preflight returned HTTP 204 with access-control-allow-headers containing x-search-session and allow-origin https://cutinapp.petertecnet.com.br
Production GET /api/v1/apps/cutinapp/global-search?q=peter&period=today returned HTTP 200 with live results including Peter Tecnet

API CI #3286: PHP syntax, Laravel cache build, migrations, canonical API routes and architecture-gate execution passed; full suite remained red due unrelated baseline failures (37 failed, 3 skipped, 469 passed)
checkpoint: Root cause fixed and validated in production: browser preflight was rejecting the frontend's X-Search-Session header because it was absent from API CORS allowed_headers. Header is now allowed, config cache rebuilt, OPTIONS returns 204 and the exact search request returns 200 with results.
next_action: Monitor search telemetry and handle the unrelated pre-existing API CI failures as a separate task; no further action required for this incident.
